purpose: Expected collected/executed/skipped/deselected counts for every test gate in .github/workflows/verify.yml. Documented in docs/CI_TEST_GATES.md. Root and backend expectations are read from docs/VERIFICATION_BASELINE.md at run time and are never copied here.

root-portable.command: PYTHONPATH=. python -m pytest tests/ with every id in .github/ci-deselect.txt deselected

expected.source: experiments/pit/KERNEL_CONSUMER_STATUS.md (focused verification) and PR #52, merged as f7b1e4f9

frontend-build.command: npm ci && npm run build (frontend/, output written outside the workspace)

not_run_in_ci.gate: native full root suite, including every id in .github/ci-deselect.txt
not_run_in_ci.reason: Byte-identity and inode-recycling checks are environment-qualified to the machine of record (docs/VERIFICATION_BASELINE.md). CI deselects them and never reports them as passed.
not_run_in_ci.where: machine of record, before any baseline refresh

not_run_in_ci.reason: Needs browser binaries, a running backend and a Supabase session; none is provided to CI.

not_run_in_ci.gate: experiment and outcome pipelines (make research, make full-research, scientific studies)
not_run_in_ci.reason: They read or regenerate protected outcomes; CI must never run them.
